category: hosted Stremio addon, private-tracker search via Jackett with debrid delivery

free_tier.stated: Free and accountless by design, but on the read date the manifest endpoint itself answered with a rate-limit placeholder: one stream titled 'Jackettio public rate-limit exceeded 🐢' pointing at https://elfhosted.com/assets/public-rate-limit-exceeded.mp4.
free_tier.notes: A manifest endpoint returning a stream list is malformed for the Stremio protocol: an installer reading this URL gets a bogus addon rather than an error.

egress.terms: No allowance or price published; the paid variant adds proxying.

interface_detail: Stremio addon over HTTPS; underlying indexer access is through Jackett, which ElfHosted also sells as its own USD 9 app.
tooling: no install; add manifest to Stremio. The private-tracker part needs a user's own Jackett/Indexer credentials - 'Indexer-backed Stremio addon using Jackett, delivered via Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, or Debrid-Link'.
chaining: The private-tracker route: it reaches indexers Torrentio does not, so it is the addon a client adds when public trackers have gone thin for a title.

limits.value: public instance throttled at the time of reading; the number is unpublished

limits_note: Rate limiting here is so tight that even the manifest is replaced, which is a stronger throttle than MediaFusion's (that one still served a valid manifest).
binding_note: Nothing byte-based is exposed; the shared request limiter is the only published constraint and it was already firing.

identity_cost.detail: Nothing to install; a debrid account and, for private trackers, indexer credentials are the real gates.

reliability_note: Public instance was over its limit on first contact. Private trackers additionally require accounts a user may not be able to obtain, which is an identity cost outside this host's control.
confidence_note: The manifest URL was fetched and returned the placeholder instead of a manifest. Not measured: the paid instance, and whether the public limit resets. Downgraded from measured: no probe record with status, bytes and digest exists.

evidence.proved: HTTP 200, 346 bytes, a streams array containing 'Jackettio public rate-limit exceeded 🐢' instead of an addon manifest
what the addon is for: 'Indexer-backed Stremio addon using Jackett, delivered via Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, or Debrid-Link'
the paid tier exists at USD 9.00 / month alongside the rest of the addon line

notes: Recorded as fails-quota rather than dead: the host is up and answering, and the failure is the free allowance, not the service.
